100.$description: Quiet fill: the research box, hover rows (#f7f8fb)

solid.$description: Refero's neutral ramp, white to near-black. The same scale exists on styles.refero.design's :root (its dark theme inverts it: 0=#101216, 900=#fff).

glass.$description: 75%-opaque greys for blurred overlays and sticky bars.

accent.$description: The three status accents Refero ships; the styles host binds the same names to --status-*.

vivid-18.$description: Vivid blue, the clearest token colour

code.$description: A 24-hue syntax ramp in two saturations. --color-code-muted-* are pastel on light / dark-mixed on dark, --color-code-vivid-* the saturated alternates; only the steps seen painted are listed (raw/css-vars.json holds all 48 per theme).

brand.$description: Constant dark shades used inside paywall and contrast blocks on the light page.
